lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill region. The central row features the largest blobs with approximately equal spacing, while the dorsal and ventral rows show smaller, more frequent local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid of anchor nodes most distinct in the mid-flank region between the pectoral and first dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the flank. The most prominent mid-lateral ridge shows a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and a well-defined shadow region immediately below, running parallel to the body longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 10-12 distinct high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated primarily in the lower two-thirds of the fin surface area, with a decreasing density toward the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density arrangement of significantly smaller, high-frequency luminance maxima compared to the larger macro-blobs found on the primary lateral flank.
